hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The lengthy practical and report substantiate associate detection and analysis skills, consistent with recorded hints; the one-year analyst scope and limited market history do not establish response leadership.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: A 24-hour detection-and-analysis practical plus report provides substantial professional SOC execution evidence despite the one-year profile and associate hints. Limited hiring history reduces familiarity, but the work sample is more informative than an entry knowledge exam.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded 24-hour detection and analysis practical plus report provides substantial delivery evidence beyond entry analyst knowledge. That supports professional placement above the associate hints, while newer market recognition limits broader senior claims.
